# WhereAnime

> Every episode date, every voice actor, every studio and song, and the order to watch each franchise in, for anime from Japan and beyond.

Data source: AniList for titles, episodes, credits, casts and air dates; AnimeThemes and AniSongDB for opening and ending songs. The site rebuilds every day.

## Pages

- /anime/<slug>: one anime, with its air dates, next episode, key staff, cast, studios and songs
- /anime/<slug>/episodes: every episode with its air date, for long-running shows
- /voice-actor/<slug>: every role a voice actor has played
- /staff/<slug>: every credit of a director, writer, composer, designer or animator
- /studio/<slug>: every show an animation studio made
- /artist/<slug>: every opening and ending song by one artist
- /watch-order/<slug>: the release order and the main story of a franchise
- /directory/<group>: A to Z lists of voice actors, staff, studios, song artists and watch orders
- /year/<year>: anime by the year it started

Status: in development, on a preview address that is not indexed.
